# NoirOps

NoirOps is an AI-powered content intelligence platform for creators and entrepreneurs.

## What NoirOps Does

- Discovers trending topics across social media platforms
- Generates platform-optimized content (posts, captions, hooks, threads, ideas)
- Creates content calendars
- Repurposes content across platforms
- Analyzes content performance with real data
- Manages brand voice configurations
- Provides AI-powered content recommendations

## Target Users

- Content creators
- Entrepreneurs and founders
- Small businesses
- Social media managers

## Platforms Supported

Instagram, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook

## Key Features

- AI Content Engine with platform awareness
- Brand Voice management
- Content Calendar with drag-and-drop
- Real-time analytics (not fabricated)
- Content history with search, filter, and CRUD
- Beta feedback system

## Status

Currently in beta. All features are free. No payment collection.

## Contact

Email: hello@noiroops.com
Web: https://noiroops.com

## Privacy

- We do not sell user data
- We do not use content to train AI models
- All user data is encrypted in transit
- See full privacy policy at https://noiroops.com/privacy
